description: This file defines a CameraHandler class responsible for managing camera-related functionalities in an Android application, including listing devices, taking photos, and recording clips, with detailed logging and error handling.

classes.name: CameraHandler
classes.description: A class that manages camera operations such as listing devices, capturing photos, and recording video clips, with integrated logging, error handling, and UI callbacks.

methods.name: isCameraClipWithinPayloadLimit
methods.description: Checks whether the given raw byte size of a camera clip is within the predefined maximum payload size.

methods.name: handleList
methods.description: Returns a list of available camera devices serialized into a JSON payload.

methods.name: handleSnap
methods.description: Handles taking a photo with the camera, including logging, UI feedback, and error management.

methods.name: handleClip
methods.description: Handles recording a camera clip, encoding it in base64, and ensuring payload size limits, with logging and error management.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters to determine if audio should be included in the clip recording.
